article_sections.h2: How the karmic tail M–N–D is worked out
paragraphs: The tail is made of three positions on the chart, set in a strict order. M is the entry to the relationship line and to the tail, and is counted as the sum of the karmic task D and the centre E. N is the middle reduction, the sum of D and M. D is the root task, the sum of the arcana of the day, the month and the year.

The order works like a phone number: the same three numbers in a different sequence give a different result and a different article. So the trio 15–8–11 is read only in that order, and an arbitrary set of arcana does not count as a tail and gets no reading of its own.

article_sections.h2: Why there are only 26 tails
paragraphs: The formulas of the matrix limit the set of reachable M–N–D by themselves. M depends on D and the centre E, N depends on D and M, so the three numbers are tied together tightly. Going through all 5,544 source matrices gives exactly 26 tails, and each one has a whole article written for it.

The practical conclusion: the catalogue of tails is finite and can be checked. A mechanical count of trios would run into several thousand, but only these 26 turn up in real charts — the formulas simply never produce the rest.

article_sections.h2: Entry M: where the familiar script begins
paragraphs: M shows the first reaction once a situation becomes truly personal: the usual move, either towards the other person or into defence. In the tail this is the entry to the script — the action, the expectation or the way of protecting yourself that sets the whole chain going.

The same point opens the relationship line M–R1–R, and that is where mistakes happen: a shared first card makes the two trios look alike, but their programs are different. Closeness runs on to R1 and R, the tail runs on to N and D. So first decide which line you are in, then read M inside it.

article_sections.h2: Middle point N: what links the entry to the root
paragraphs: N is counted from D and M and shows the mechanism of the move between them: how the first reaction carries a person all the way to the root question. This is the most context-bound position of the tail — on its own it reads badly, but inside the chain it explains why the familiar story does not stop at the first step.

The same energy in the middle of different tails answers different questions, so the general meaning of the arcanum gives you little here. Strength in the middle of 15–8–11 is about the habit of pulling everything alone, while in another trio the same card sounds different. That is why the article for a tail is kept whole instead of being assembled from three separate cards.

article_sections.h2: Root D: the question the chain keeps returning to
paragraphs: D closes the order M–N–D and names the way of answering that is due for a rethink. It is the same karmic task that stands at the very bottom of the chart — the sum of the arcana of the day, the month and the year; inside the tail it is read not as a task for a whole life but as the root of one repeating story.

The reading here leans on current decisions: where the chain has already shown itself, which consequences came back, which action could change what happens next. D is not proof of a past life and it is not a punishment either: it describes a habit whose consequences you can see. There is one practical question — what do you do next time in the same place.

article_sections.h2: How to read the whole article for a tail
paragraphs: Start with the short story of the tail, then go through the roles in order — M, N, D — and only after that move on to the risks and the practice. That order repeats the chain itself: entry, mechanism, root.

An arcanum you know from another page drags a ready-made meaning along with it, while here the sense is set by the position inside this particular tail. A strong conclusion ties the three steps into one sentence and shows where the sequence can still be stopped: the place where there was a choice, and a different action in that place.

article_sections.h2: Why only some tails have a page of their own
paragraphs: All 26 tails have been worked out, but the open catalogue holds the ones with search demand of their own and enough material behind them. The rest are read inside your own chart: the text is there in full, it simply has no separate page in search.

For a reader this changes one thing: looking for your own trio in the list of pages can be pointless, and it is safer to open the chart by date of birth and read the tail there. The encyclopedia stays complete either way — the method is described in full, rare trios included.

article_sections.h2: An example tail: 15–8–11
paragraphs: Take the reference matrix 4–3–22: the karmic tail comes out as 15–8–11. The Devil at the entry is a strong pull and the bill for that same pull — a person knows how to want things and how to get material results, and right beside that stands dependence on people, on possessions or on work.

Strength in the middle turns this into the habit of pulling alone: asking is not allowed, and the person is honestly surprised that nobody around helps. Justice at the end sets the present task — a feeling of an unpaid bill that gets carried over to new people until the mechanism is noticed. The first step out of such a chain is small: one request for help, said straight out.

article_sections.h2: Practice without literally believing in past incarnations
paragraphs: You can treat the subject in different ways: literally, as past incarnations, or as a description of the habits a person arrived with. The check does not change either way: what you work on is a concrete repeating episode, not the history of a soul.

Pick two recent episodes with a similar sequence of actions. Mark the entry M, the move N and the root answer D, then find the place where there was still a choice. Try one alternative action in the next small situation and watch what follows. This kind of move works with behaviour you can observe, and the mystical guess stays outside the conclusion.

faq.q: What do the tasks of past incarnations show in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: A script that starts by itself, with no decision from you. The three arcana of the tail, M–N–D, describe the entry into the story, the mechanism of the move and the root question the chain returns to. Until the script is named, a person takes it for their own character.

faq.q: How do I read past incarnations in the destiny matrix from three arcana?
faq.a: In the order M → N → D, and as one text. M is the first reaction, N is the mechanism that carries you to the root, D is the question that needs a new answer. Three separate arcanum descriptions added together do not replace this: the meaning is set by the position inside this particular tail.

faq.q: Are past lives in the destiny matrix meant literally?
faq.a: The method works without that belief. The tail holds a script that starts automatically, and it is read from the decisions you repeat right now. The section establishes no historical or supernatural facts.

faq.q: How many karmic tails does this method have?
faq.a: Exactly 26 tails M–N–D are reachable. The formulas tie the three numbers to each other, so arbitrary trios never appear in a chart, and each of the 26 results has a whole article written for it.

faq.q: Does the order of the numbers in the karmic tail matter?
faq.a: Yes. M, N and D answer different questions: entry, move, root. Swapping the numbers gives a different sequence and a different reading, so the trio is read only in the order M–N–D.

items.title: Your purpose
items.lead: Four levels: personal, social, spiritual and planetary.
items.formula: personal, social, spiritual and planetary purpose
meaning: Your purpose in the destiny matrix is the final zone of the chart, the one that answers the question “why am I here and where am I taking my life”. It does not describe character or a single ability, the way the other points do; it gathers them into one task — what a person was given their whole set of energies for. So purpose is read not as a trait but as a direction: the thing a person arrives at once they stop scattering themselves.

By meaning this is the top of the chart, not its base. The centre and the lines say what a person is made of; purpose shows what all of it adds up to at the output. It is split into four levels — personal, social, spiritual and planetary — because “why do I live” sounds different to the person themselves, to the people around them, and to whatever is left after them. One level filled while the rest stay empty gives a tilt: either pure self-realisation with nothing given back to people, or service to everyone with emptiness inside.

A strong showing can be seen in the calm: a person is busy with their own thing and does not envy anyone else’s road, the work gives strength instead of only taking it, and help to others comes out of surplus rather than duty. A weak one is the tossing between “I have to earn” and “I want more meaning”, the feeling of living a life that is not yours, and a dull irritation at those who have found theirs. Purpose here is not a line in a work record: two people in the same trade can stand on different tasks, and people from different fields on the same one.

This zone shapes the main forks: what to take up seriously, what to put up with the hard parts for, where to draw strength when everything outward is already in place and the joy is not. You cannot reach your purpose by somebody else’s yardstick of success — it is almost always quieter and plainer than you expect, yet it holds a person for years and does not need constant prodding. It opens up gradually, with experience rather than with the age in your passport.
items.reading: Go from the bottom up: personal, social, spiritual, planetary. Skipping a level gives you fine words and no result.

article_sections.h2: What purpose means in the destiny matrix
paragraphs: Purpose in the destiny matrix is four calculated points, and each has its own question. The personal level answers what kind of person you have to become yourself. The social one covers the work that makes you useful to strangers. The spiritual level ties the first two together. The planetary one shows what stays after you.

In the reading the section looks like four cards: the arcanum number, its name and four captions — “Essence”, “Strength”, “Risk”, “Action”. Below the cards comes the summary: the main strength, the main tension and a practical step. The cards are read in order, from the personal level up to the planetary one: every next level rests on the previous one, and a conversation started at the top quickly turns into fine words.

article_sections.h2: Personal level: the quality you live through yourself
paragraphs: The personal arcanum is counted from two totals — the sky line B–D and the earth line A–C. Its question is an awkward one: what did you put off “until later” some ten years ago. This is about your own life — what to learn, what to stop tolerating, which boundary to hold.

There is nobody to praise you for this level: it is tested by the decisions a person makes alone with themselves. While the line stays empty, the same familiar picture repeats — a person helps others a lot, gets praised for it, and is hollow inside. The first step is a small one: name one thing from the last three months that you finished for yourself and not for somebody else’s approval.

article_sections.h2: Social level: what people come to you for
paragraphs: The second level is assembled from the totals of the male family branch F–H and the female one G–I. The formula comes from the family line, but it obliges nobody to carry on an ancestor’s craft: the resource of the two sides adds up into something that becomes visible among people. The question of this level is simple — what do strangers already come to you for.

Being public matters least of all here: the craftsman people travel from another city to see stands on exactly this level, only more quietly. The line is checked by feedback — a real recipient, a task that got solved, a process that keeps working after you walk away. A check like that weighs more than a dream of recognition.

article_sections.h2: Spiritual level: where the personal and the social meet
paragraphs: The spiritual arcanum is the sum of the personal and the social, reduced to a number from 1 to 22. It appears where your own work and your use to people stop pulling in different directions: a person does what matters to them, other people need it, and one no longer has to be betrayed for the sake of the other.

The state itself is thoroughly earthly. You recognise it by the occupation that leaves an even feeling behind: emptiness and guilt go out of it. In the reading the text of this card speaks about the agreement of two levels, while the personal and social readings stand above it as separate blocks. While one of the sides is empty, the spiritual level reads like a slogan: pure self-realisation away from people, or service to all comers with emptiness inside.

article_sections.h2: Planetary level: what outlives a biography
paragraphs: The planetary arcanum is made from the social and the spiritual levels, and the family branches reach it through the social one. The name is loud, the look is everyday: a teacher who has sent out thirty classes; a third-generation engineer; a method that strangers use.

Its practical question is gentler than any mission — what are you doing that will outlive you by a couple of generations. An empty line here simply points at where to look once the personal levels are closed. And the order is strict: personal and social purpose first, this point after that, otherwise you end up with fine words and no deeds.

article_sections.h2: How to read the moves between the four levels
paragraphs: The reading order repeats the formulas. The personal level is assembled from the sky and earth lines, the social one from the two family branches, the spiritual one equals the sum of the personal and the social, the planetary one the sum of the social and the spiritual. Hence the rule: the two lower cards first, then the two upper ones.

For each role find one verb and one fact from the last few months, then check the move — has the quality of the previous level held, and has a new recipient appeared. If you are pulled towards starting from the planetary level, go back to the nearest gap: to the quality that is not yours yet, or to the use that nobody can confirm so far.

article_sections.h2: One arcanum on two levels: how to read that
paragraphs: The levels are counted out of one another: the spiritual one is the sum of the personal and the social, the planetary one the sum of the social and the spiritual. That is why the same number lands on two positions at once for roughly every eighth date of birth. Both cards are printed in full, the questions of the roles stay different, and telling them apart is up to you.

One and the same arcanum asks “who to become” on the personal level, “who needs this” on the social one, and “how to hold both answers at once” on the spiritual one. Different numbers rarely argue either: they show one quality translated to the next scale. Compare what each role asks you to do, and leave the strength of the numbers aside.

article_sections.h2: An example path: 22–8–3–11
paragraphs: Levels of purpose in the reference matrix 4–3–22 add up to 22–8–3–11. The Fool on the personal level allows a person to start from a blank page as many times as needed — and the same place hides the slide into running from commitments. Strength on the social level turns this into a calm support: next to such a person people hold on where they usually break.

The Empress on the spiritual level adds a generosity that grows living things — on condition that a person gives away as much as stays a joy and does not become a tally. Justice on the planetary level takes the theme out to a fair measure: an agreement, a rule, a conflict talked through. Four different arcana mean that every move here is made by a decision of its own.

article_sections.h2: Practice: find the nearest scale of growth
paragraphs: Write the four levels out in a column and put one confirmed fact from the last three months beside each of them. The first level with an empty line is your nearest piece of work, even if the top one looks prettier from the outside.

Set yourself one step for the week with a recipient, a deadline and a visible result: a text sent, a conversation held, a stage finished. A week later check two things — has the personal quality stayed with you, and did anyone get real use out of it. After that move one level up, and correct the wording by the facts.

faq.q: How do I understand my purpose from the destiny matrix?
faq.a: It is four calculated points: personal, social, spiritual and planetary. The personal one says who to become, the social one what you are useful for to strangers, the spiritual one joins them together, the planetary one shows what lives longer than your biography. They are read in order, from the personal level up to the planetary one.

faq.q: Does purpose match your profession?
faq.a: No. A profession describes the format of the work, while purpose is one quality carried through four scales. It shows up at work, in the family and in public matters alike: two people in the same trade often stand on different tasks.

faq.q: How is purpose calculated in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Four arcana are counted from the date of birth. The personal one comes from the totals of the sky line B–D and the earth line A–C, the social one from the totals of the two family branches, the spiritual one is the sum of the personal and the social, the planetary one the sum of the social and the spiritual. Every number is then read as a separate question.

faq.q: How do personal and social purpose differ?
faq.a: Personal purpose covers your own life: what to learn, what to stop tolerating, which boundary to hold. Social purpose covers the work that strangers come to you for. The order of work is stubborn — your own part first, the public part after it.

faq.q: Why does the section have four levels of purpose?
faq.a: The question “why do I live” sounds different to the person themselves, to the people around them, and to what will remain after them. Four levels separate these answers and show the tilt: either pure self-realisation with nothing given back to people, or service to everyone with emptiness inside.

items.title: Money in the destiny matrix
items.lead: Where money comes easily and where the channel is blocked.
items.formula: the whole money channel and the result of the earth line
meaning: Money in the destiny matrix is the money channel of the chart: a separate line of points that shows not how much a person will earn, but the way income reaches them most easily. For one person the flow opens through voice and selling, for another through hands and craft, for a third through the people they keep around them. It is not about the sum in the account, it is about the course along which money runs naturally.

The position is called a channel because money here is a flow, not a store. It describes the course of income: which action it is born from and how firmly it stands on the ground, whether there is daily order under it and the habit of counting. While a person moves along their own course, the flow almost carries itself; switch to someone else’s way of earning and the same result costs three times as much and drains away faster.

A strong money channel is recognised by ease: income comes from what the person likes doing anyway, money stays, something grows out of it. A weak one is an endless race: there are earnings, but they run through the fingers, large sums frighten, and the work you love seems impossible to be paid for. Usually the issue is not the size of the talent but that for years the person has been selling themselves in a way the chart never set for them.

The money line shapes the choice of trade and the form of income, the attitude to spending and saving, and how easy it is to ask to be paid for your work. It promises no wealth and forbids none — it shows the shortest road to money and the place where people habitually block that road for themselves.
items.reading: Look at the entry, the condition, the result and the earth support. The hole is usually in the second arcanum, where the condition has gone unmet for years.

article_sections.h2: What the money line shows in the destiny matrix
paragraphs: The money line is four points, and the report labels them in words: the entry of the money line L, the money direction R2, the crossing of money and relationships R, and the earth outcome. The entry is counted from the material task and the centre of the chart, the earth outcome from the personality portrait and the same material task. They are read as one chain, from entry to outcome.

The line answers the question of in what way, not of how much. It shows which action income is born from, what holds it, where it turns into an agreement with people, and what is left of it a year later. Check it against your budget, the agreements you have closed, and whether the result repeated at least twice.

article_sections.h2: L — the entry: which action income starts from
paragraphs: Point L is counted as the sum of the material task and the centre. It is the first verb of money movement: to offer, to name a price, to gather people, to explain, to see a thing through. Strength at the entry opens the line through endurance: the person stays calm where others break down, and that steadiness is what gets paid for. The Fool enters through risk and novelty, the Hierophant through the explanation after which everything becomes clear.

Test the entry on two cases from your own life where an opportunity appeared after your action, not after someone else’s call. If the same verb worked in both, that is your entry. Every arcanum here has its price: the Eight endures for years instead of having one conversation, and then the entry turns into unpaid work.

article_sections.h2: R2 — the direction: what keeps income going
paragraphs: R2 is labelled in the report as the money direction and is made up of the entry L and the crossing R. It is the condition under which the first impulse turns into repeatable income: rhythm, a narrow speciality, simple bookkeeping, live contact with people, the readiness to close what is finished on time.

Death in the direction sounds short: money likes clean endings — debts closed, things sold in time, a loss-making venture stopped. The Emperor holds the direction with a system and long contracts, the Fool holds it with novelty, and then bookkeeping becomes the weak spot. Write the condition down as a rule you will repeat next month by yourself, without anyone’s approval and without a lucky turn of events.

article_sections.h2: R — where money meets people
paragraphs: R is the crossing point of money and relationships, the sum of the entry L and the lower inner point M. Here the money question becomes a conversation: price, share, deadlines, what is included in the work and what already counts as a separate service. It stands third in the line, and on it an available opportunity turns into an accepted obligation.

The Hierophant at this point sells understanding: a reading, teaching, the right to tell people how it should be done. Money here is even, without spikes, and only one expectation gets in the way — learn everything first, charge later. The practical step is simple: set a price for one hour and sell it before you feel fully ready.

article_sections.h2: The earth outcome — what is left after a cycle
paragraphs: The earth outcome is counted from the personality portrait and the material task — it is the earth line, where the material part of the chart comes together. In a money reading it is read as the quality that makes what you earned stay: finishing, sharing out, a clear account, a reserve for the next cycle.

The check is simple: a result is locked in when you can repeat it and explain it to another person in words. A one-off earning that came by chance and is hard to explain has nothing to do with the earth outcome yet. If the outcome matches the entry, the whole cycle rests on one quality — and on its price, which you will pay twice.

article_sections.h2: How to read the four steps in a row
paragraphs: The line is read as steps, and each one has its own question: did the entry become a direction, did the direction become an agreement, did the agreement become support. Three steps, three places where the process usually tears.

A common break is the jump from the entry straight to the outcome: the start is strong, the rule for holding on is not there yet, and money passes right through. The direct link from L to the earth outcome is used only to check the whole chain at once. Find your own break: how far the current process gets and where it stops every time.

article_sections.h2: Repeats and tensions on the money line
paragraphs: One and the same arcanum in two money points strengthens a familiar way and repeats its price along with it. Speed helps you enter and decide, and the same speed keeps you from keeping accounts. Endurance holds both the entry and the outcome, but it trains you to do more than everyone and ask for less than everyone.

Different arcana need translation: the impulse of the entry has to become clear to the next role. Between the points it helps to set a rule of passage — a deadline, a document, a minimum volume, a mark of completion. Then the step rests on an agreement, and mood and inspiration stop deciding whether the process reaches money.

article_sections.h2: An example of the money line 8–13–5–8
paragraphs: The four money points of the reference matrix 4–3–22 give 8–13–5–8. The entry is Strength: people pay for stamina and reliability, for long work and difficult projects. The direction is Death: the income that lasts is the one you cleared of what was finished in time, while dragging a dead project along out of pity for what you put in costs the most here.

The crossing is the Hierophant: they pay for explanation and expertise, not for being present nearby. The earth outcome is Strength again: the cycle closes with the same quality it started with, and that is also its weak spot — being modest about the price. There is one working step for such a line: put a price on your reliability and name separately which help is already included in it.

article_sections.h2: Practice: a week on one stretch of the line
paragraphs: Take a money process that is running right now and mark which of the four points it has reached. Improving the whole line at once makes no sense: pick the nearest break and set one action — send an offer, write down the terms, name a price, close a stage.

A week later look at the facts: what they answered, what they signed, how much time it took. Refine the reading of the arcana on your own data: fact first, explanation after. This round takes seven days and gives more than a month of reading descriptions.

faq.q: What does money show in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Four points of the money line: the entry L, the direction R2, the crossing of money and relationships R, and the earth outcome. Together they describe the way income comes most easily and the place where it is usually lost. The line does not work out the sum, the payment date or the source of income.

faq.q: Where do I look for the arcanum of money in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: The entry stands on the right inner point L, the direction R2 sits between the entry and the crossing, R lies where the money line crosses the relationship line, and the earth outcome is on the earth line, where the personality portrait and the material task meet. All four are labelled in words in the report, so you will not have to hunt for them on the scheme by hand.

faq.q: Destiny matrix money by date of birth — what exactly is counted from the date?
faq.a: The date of birth gives the arcana of four points: L comes from the material task and the centre, R from L and the lower inner point, R2 from L and R, and the earth outcome from the personality portrait and the material task. Every number is reduced to the range from 1 to 22.

faq.q: One arcanum on two money points — what does that mean?
faq.a: One way works in two roles at once: endurance, for example, holds both the entry and the outcome. The strong side becomes more visible, but its price is paid twice. Take the use and the risk apart for each point separately.

faq.q: Can I choose a trade by the money line?
faq.a: The line shows the way of earning, while a trade is checked against the talent line B–P–K, your skills and demand. A more useful question is another one: does what you are doing now use your entry or argue with it?

meaning: The title of this section is easy to take as a promise of a sharp turn on your birthday. There is no such switch in the calculation: the section takes two positions of the money circuit — the inner node R2 and the entry L — and reads them through the question of a mature way of earning.

The angle is useful because the price of decisions really does change with experience. Where speed and a large number of attempts used to save the day, reputation, the choice of projects and the ability to stop selling an hour where you can already sell a system may matter more later. But that is a life hypothesis to test, not an event the arcana switch on automatically at forty.

R2 is read first — what happens inside the money channel, where resource meets choice and limits. Then L shows the entry into the channel: through which action or quality a person plugs into the money story. Their pairing helps you ask not how much will I get, but which old way of earning already costs me more than the result.

A practical check is to compare three periods of your working life: what brought money, what ate your strength, and what people came back for a second time. If the description matches the facts, use it as a direction for an experiment. If it does not, your age and a fine section title should not argue with reality.

article_sections.h2: What really changes in a money reading after 40
paragraphs: The formula and the numbers of the arcana stay the same after forty. What changes is the order of reading: the money direction R2 first, the entry L second. That is how the section is built in the report — direction first, entry second — and this is what makes it different from the general money line, where everything starts with the entry.

The reason for the reversal is simple: by forty there is material that used to be scarce — finished projects, repeat clients, the bill for your own mistakes. First you look at what of this survived several rounds, and only then decide how to enter the next venture. The section promises no financial turning point on your birthday.

article_sections.h2: Why the mature angle starts with R2
paragraphs: In an early reading attention goes to the entry: where to look for an opportunity, what to start with, who to offer it to. After twenty years of work the question is different — which direction has already proved that it holds: the same subject, the same circle of people, the same way of doing business.

R2 is made up of the entry L and the crossing of money and relationships R, so it holds everything a person has managed to find out about the price of their work and about agreements with people. Reading it first means taking an inventory: confirmed rules, contacts built up over the years, honest limits. Nobody hands out marks of success or failure here.

article_sections.h2: R2 — the gathered direction and the filter for new work
paragraphs: The arcanum of the direction gives the principle by which new money tasks are chosen: depth, system, contact, autonomy, speed, renewal. Test it on finished projects — not on the brightest success, but on the repeatable condition under which the work gave a clear result every time.

The thirteenth arcanum in this role turns the collapses you lived through into capital: the person counts risks faster than the rest, and that raises the price of their work. The Five with experience leans on a name in the trade: the same knowledge costs more where a proven reputation stands behind it, and what has been gathered adds up to teaching, mentoring or a method of your own — if the person takes that up.

article_sections.h2: L — a new entry built on experience
paragraphs: Once the direction has been read, the entry is read afresh: how to open the next opportunity knowing what you already know. It can be a more precisely worded offer, turning down a format that does not fit, a bet on reputation, or a trial of a smaller size instead of one large move.

A mature entry rarely looks like a sharp turn. More often it is a different order of the same familiar actions: price first, work after; written terms first, first step after. The Eight at the entry, for example, stops taking the weight silently and starts naming which part of the help is already included in its price.

article_sections.h2: The R2↔L link: the filter of experience and the right to try
paragraphs: The pair shows the pull between a rule built up over years and the willingness to start again. Experience works as a filter while it screens out what is unnecessary; the same experience turns into a cage when any new format is rejected in advance, before the first attempt.

The opposite tilt is familiar too: constant fresh starts devalue the support already built, and every year begins from a blank page. A working conclusion keeps one proven condition of the direction and allows one experiment at the entry — with a limited deadline, a budget and a stopping point set in advance.

article_sections.h2: The age frame: what it is good for and where it ends
paragraphs: Age here is a reason to compare the facts you have gathered, not a timetable of events. The section does not forecast the size of income or the date of a job change: the result rests on the market, your strength, obligations to the people close to you, your skills and your own decisions.

Useful work with the frame looks like this: three periods of your working life and three answers — what brought money, what ate your strength, what people came back to you for. If the description of the pair matches the facts, take it as a direction for an experiment. Big money decisions are still made by arithmetic, and the symbols stay a hint towards the question.

article_sections.h2: If the old money method still works
paragraphs: The section suggests keeping a system that holds and rebuilding only what already costs more than the result. The direction is confirmed, the entry works, the price of keeping it up is bearable — then a fair conclusion of the reading sounds like leave it as it is.

Check one thing: what all of it rests on. One client, one role, one person who brings the orders — the whole system stands on one leg. A useful question here: what happens to your income if this source goes quiet for two months? The experiment is then needed for a second small support — a second format of work, a second circle of customers, a separate reserve for the pause between projects.

article_sections.h2: An example of the mature angle 13–8
paragraphs: After 40 the reference matrix 4–3–22 gives the money angle as the pair 13–8. The direction R2 is Death. In an early reading it meant the ability to drop things and leave; with experience it reads differently: the right not to return to what has already ended, and the skill of counting a risk before everyone else.

The entry L is Strength. It used to be the sheer volume carried; now it is the reputation of a person who gets things done: people come to you when everything is on fire, and that is worth more than any hourly rate. You can charge that price once the experience is backed by the work itself. Age changes the question, and the numbers stay the same: 13 and 8.

article_sections.h2: Practice for a mature money experiment
paragraphs: Start two columns. In the first write down what has worked at least twice in a repeatable way, in the second what you keep doing out of habit. From the first pick one condition of the direction, from the second one entry to rebuild.

Then three numbers: the term of the experiment, the budget, and the point at which you stop. A month later count the result: how many replies came in, how many agreements closed, what your hour cost. Those three lines are the test of the mature angle, and waiting for an age-related turning point adds nothing to them.

faq.q: How does money change after 40 in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: The order of reading changes: first the money direction R2 — what has already proved steady — then the entry L, the way into the next opportunity. The arcana and the formula stay the same; all that is added is the gathered material to test them on.

faq.q: What does money after 40 mean in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Two points of the money circuit read through the question of a mature way of earning: the gathered direction and a new entry. The section helps you name which old method already costs more than the result and choose one change instead of a full rebuild.

faq.q: How do I read income after 40 by date of birth?
faq.a: You need the arcana of two points, and both are counted from the date of birth: R2 is made up of the entry and the crossing of money and relationships, L of the material task and the centre of the chart. Then you check them against three periods of your working life: what brought money, what ate your strength, what people came back to you for.

faq.q: Do I have to change my job or trade after forty?
faq.a: No. A method that holds can be kept, and that is a fair conclusion of the reading. Rebuilding often means a small change: different terms, a different price, a second support in case the main stream of orders dries up.

faq.q: Do the arcana of the money line change at 40?
faq.a: The calculation stays the same: the numbers come from the date of birth and are not recounted at forty. What changes is the order of the questions and the amount of facts the reading can be tested against.

items.title: Relationships in the destiny matrix
items.lead: What you bring into a couple and what you look for in the other person.
items.formula: the relationship line M–R1–R and the inner upper point K
meaning: This line of the chart describes not a perfect partner but you yourself inside a couple: what you bring into a union, what you look for in it and at which turn you usually trip. It is your own script for closeness, not a forecast of who suits you; compatibility with a particular person is counted separately and leans on this line.

The line has a definite route M→R1→R. M shows the first personal impulse: how a person enters closeness and what they do when they become exposed. R1 opens the inner knot of the couple — the place of choice, of pull or of a conflict that repeats. R shows what form of union this way of building relationships leads to.

A strong version of the line is when a person notices their own script from outside and can both give and take: relationships become a meeting place instead of a patch for an inner hole. Under tension one story repeats from bond to bond — being unavailable looks like passion at first, and then turns into loneliness for two again.

The female family point G and the talent point K can add extra context, but they are not counted as the beginning and the end of the love channel. M, R1 and R are better read as a sequence: where it all starts, where the main knot appears, and what union comes out if the reaction stays the same.
items.reading: Read M–R1–R as the entry, the main knot and the shape of the union, and K as the inner resource that helps you keep yourself in close relationships. All four roles belong to the section reading and are read together.

article_sections.h2: What the relationship line is made of
paragraphs: The line is made of four points. M is the entry into closeness, and it also sits on the fork with the karmic tail. R1 is the partner point. R is the crossing of money and relationships. K is the inner point of talent, your personal resource inside a couple. In the reading they stand in this order, and the handy way to take them is as a route: where a person starts, where they trip, what form of union they arrive at and what they help themselves with. The talk here is about your own script for closeness; compatibility with a particular person is counted separately, from two dates of birth. So the first step is to recognise yourself in the description of the entry, and only then move further along the line.

article_sections.h2: M — what you do in the first two weeks
paragraphs: Point M stands on the fork of the relationship line and the karmic tail, so the first reaction here is double: part of the impulse is your own, part is old and well practised. At the entry one person speeds up and gets close within a week, another watches and checks that it is safe, a third states the rules straight away, a fourth starts caring before anyone asked. In the reference calculation 4–3–22 The Devil stands at this point: the pull is powerful and the bill for it arrives later. Check M against your latest acquaintance — what you did in the first two weeks, how the other person answered, how it ended. The same reaction can fit one couple and get in the way in the next.

article_sections.h2: R1 — the question that surfaces after you get close
paragraphs: The partner point shows the theme that comes through once the first attraction has settled: trust, freedom, control, recognition, equality, limits. In the reading it stands second and is labelled as the partner point. The twentieth arcanum in this role looks for agreement on the main things and quietly keeps score on the partner along the way; sooner or later the score is read out loud, and better before it is closed. A working wording for R1 is always tied to behaviour: silence instead of a request, a test instead of a direct question, a joke instead of an answer. The theme stays where it is, and the behaviour inside it a person chooses themselves — which is why R1 is read as a question to yourself.

article_sections.h2: R — how a personal theme turns into a rule for the couple
paragraphs: The third point sits at the crossing of money and relationships: here the inner question becomes agreements — who pays, who decides, what the couple keeps quiet about. It helps to tell a rule that was said out loud from an expectation the other person finds out about at the moment of hurt. The Hierophant in this role, as in the reference calculation, keeps the union on explained rules and on talking; its tilt is to give a lecture where someone asked for help. The practical output of the section here is one thing: a phrase you can bring into a conversation. “I have agreed this with myself, let us check it together” works; an accusation in the shape of “you always do this” closes the conversation.

article_sections.h2: K — what a person helps themselves with in a couple
paragraphs: The inner point of talent works in this section as a personal resource: the quality that helps you stay a participant in the relationship and keep yourself inside it. Sometimes that is clarity, sometimes flexibility, the skill of holding a pause or of closing a conversation with an agreement. The Chariot in the reference matrix brings back speed and drive — it arrives first as long as the wheel stays in your hands. The sign of a working resource is simple: it changes your own action in the next conversation. If the other person has to become more convenient before it switches on, what you have is a demand on the partner. K is read last, after R, so that the quality is applied to a form of union you already understand.

article_sections.h2: Reading order: the entry first, the knot second
paragraphs: The route of the reading is this: M, then R1, then R, and only after that K is matched against R and against M. First you find the entry into closeness, then the moment where the main question switches on, then the form the couple actually gets. Starting with K turns the resource into general advice of the “be more flexible” kind: it stays unclear which step to apply it to. The link back from K to M is needed for the final check — does the chosen quality change the very first automatic step, the one you make in the first days of an acquaintance. Such an order keeps the reading short and testable on a single episode.

article_sections.h2: The same arcanum in two points of the line
paragraphs: One number in two roles makes a familiar way stronger, but the roles ask different questions. The Chariot at the entry is the pace of getting close. The same Chariot in the resource is the ability to pull yourself together and carry a conversation to the end. A match is a hint worth taking: one theme means one risk, and it will surface twice — first in the opening reaction, then in the rules of the couple. Different numbers in the points show what translation is needed between impulse, need and agreement. The line describes a sequence, so different arcana inside it are normal, not a broken script.

article_sections.h2: Example: the closeness script 15–20–5–7
paragraphs: In the reference calculation 4–3–22 the relationship line looks like 15–20–5–7. The Devil at the entry gives a powerful pull and the bill for that same pull: the passion is real and so is the dependence on it. Judgement in the partner point asks the person to admit what they actually want rather than what they want out of habit, and to stop keeping a silent score. The Hierophant in the form of union says it plainly: agreements here hold on words spoken out loud. The Chariot in the resource adds speed, and the same speed carries you off if the wheel is dropped. The whole chain in one line: wanted it badly, weighed it for a long time, explained the rules, drove off. The weak spot is the second step, where the score stays unsaid.

article_sections.h2: Practice: one conversation instead of a forecast
paragraphs: Take a calm episode from the past few weeks. Write out four lines: what you did (M), which question stayed unsaid (R1), which rule actually works for you (R), which quality would have helped (K). Build one request out of all this, in the first person — short, about a concrete situation, leaving the other person the right to answer “not now”. Try it on a quiet day and judge the result by the quality of contact. If there is danger or fear in the relationship, the symbolic reading is put aside: safety and support from a trained specialist come first, the arcana later.

faq.q: What do relationships show in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Four points of the line: the entry into closeness, the partner question, the form of agreements and the inner resource. Together they add up to a personal script — how a person gets close, what they trip over and what union they arrive at. This is a description of your behaviour in a couple, not a portrait of a future partner.

faq.q: Which relationship arcana take part in the calculation?
faq.a: The entry arcanum M, the partner point R1, point R at the crossing of money and relationships, and the inner point of talent K. Each number is read together with its role: the same arcanum at the entry and in the resource answers different questions.

faq.q: Where does the love line run on the chart?
faq.a: Its entry coincides with the fork of the karmic tail, then come the partner point and the crossing of money with relationships. The resource point K lies on the talent line and joins last. In the reading all four are labelled with their own names, so you do not have to hunt for them on the scheme.

faq.q: Can the destiny matrix tell me when I will meet a partner?
faq.a: No. The method does not calculate dates of meeting, marriage or parting, and it does not account for the decisions of the other person. The section works with your repeating script: what you do first and what rule grows out of it.

faq.q: How is a personal script for closeness different from the compatibility of two dates?
faq.a: A script is built from one date of birth and takes your own reactions apart. Compatibility is counted from two dates and answers a different question — how a particular couple works out. The personal line is read first: it explains what you bring into any union.

items.title: Karma of relationships with parents and children
items.lead: Which family rules you received and which habits you pass on.
items.formula: the spiritual family points F and G, the material male point H
meaning: A family script usually gives itself away in a stray sentence: you hear your own voice and suddenly recognise the tone of a parent you argued with all your life. The section “Parents and children” exists for exactly these repeats — to notice what came from the family and what now gets passed on automatically.

In the product this view is built from three canonical points: the spiritual male line F, the spiritual female line G and the material male line H. They do not make up a separate formula for a child and they do not predict how many children you will have. The trio is a way of talking about family values and about everyday models of behaviour.

A strong reading does not hand out blame. It helps you split the inheritance: keep the ability to care, to hold your word or to stand up for the people close to you, without repeating the control, the silence and the strain that used to come with it. Then your parents’ way stops being the only script available.

Check the conclusions against real episodes: how people in the family asked for help, how they reacted to a mistake, how much freedom they gave and how they made peace after a quarrel. With no children of your own the section still works — read it through your parents and through the habits you pass on to younger people, to students or to friends, without inventing a forecast about offspring.
items.reading: Compare F and G with the rules of your family, then compare H with the material actions of the male branch. After that, check which of the things you found you are passing on.

article_sections.h2: What the “Parents and children” section shows
paragraphs: The section gathers three canonical points: the spiritual male line F, the spiritual female line G and the material male line H. The first two are principles received from the family; the third is the way you carry them on yourself — how you explain, where you set a limit, what you praise, how you react when someone else gets it wrong. The trio describes family values and everyday models of behaviour, and the number of children stays outside it. What it does show well is the repeat: the sentence you swore never to say, which still flies out at the right moment. The section works for a person without children too — H appears in care, in teaching, in leading, in any relationship where someone more vulnerable stands next to you.

article_sections.h2: F — the rule of the male branch
paragraphs: Point F offers a guess about how the male branch handled responsibility, boundaries, movement and results. The arcanum names the principle; the facts come from you — sentences you overheard, decisions you know about, your own experience of talking to these people. The Chariot in this role, for example, keeps the rule “move fast and arrive first”, and along with that strength it passes on the heavy side: the habit of knocking people over at your own speed. When you know little about your relatives, it is more honest to leave the meaning as an open question and work on the rule you can see in yourself. Such a reading comes out shorter, but you can test it against a real episode.

article_sections.h2: G — the rule of the female branch
paragraphs: The female branch gives the second angle, and reducing it to care, feelings and housekeeping because of the name alone is the most common mistake. Here the arcanum names a way of acting that the household treated as the right one, and it is tested by the same facts: how people asked for help, how they reacted to a mistake, how they made peace after a row, how much freedom they gave. It helps to separate the skill from its usual price. The ability to support sits next to silence about your own needs; self-reliance sits next to difficulty in accepting help. Either conclusion is worth something only with an example: one case, one sentence, one episode you still remember.

article_sections.h2: H — what you pass on
paragraphs: The material male line shows what a person does with the inheritance next: how they explain the rules, where they set a limit, what they praise, how they hand out responsibility and what they say when someone else has got it wrong. The position becomes clear once you turn the noun into a verb: instead of “strictness”, say “I raise my voice every other time”. Then you can see what is worth keeping and which automatic reaction to swap for something calmer and more deliberate. The Lovers in this role, as in the reference chart, draw people in easily and demand a choice — and then pass on the habit of putting the decision off to the last minute.

article_sections.h2: F and G: two rules in one person
paragraphs: Start by comparing the two received principles with each other. They can pull together, or they can give different answers to the same situation: one branch says endure and keep your face, the other says walk out and slam the door. The point of the comparison is to catch the moment of the inner argument — which rule fires first, what it protects, whether there is a third move that keeps the value of both sides. Asking “who influenced me more” leads nowhere: both branches are already inside and argue in your voice. It is more useful to name the situation where you hear that argument most often; usually it comes back year after year.

article_sections.h2: From the rule you received to your own action
paragraphs: Match each branch against H separately: first F→H, then G→H. That shows what you carry on from the father’s rule and what from the mother’s, and keeps the two steps apart instead of blurring them into an impersonal “family total”. If the number in H matches F or G, the role is still different: a principle you received and your own action towards someone younger and weaker are not the same thing. One of the two steps is usually easy and already clear to you; the second shows up in small things — in your tone, in how fast you say no, in the way you explain your decision to a child or a student.

article_sections.h2: How to talk about family in the first person
paragraphs: Speaking in the first person changes the whole reading: “I learned”, “I keep doing”, “I want to change”. Even a family rule you have confirmed grew out of someone else’s circumstances — a move to another town, poverty, years when there was little to choose from — and it stops being a verdict on a relative. The section gives you material for your own choice; judging a parent’s character from a distance, or demanding that they accept your version of the past, takes the reading out of the area where it works. What you can change is your own way of speaking, of setting limits and of giving support — the part of the inheritance you can reach today.

article_sections.h2: A worked example: 7–7–6
paragraphs: Roles in the reference matrix 4–3–22 come out as 7–7–6. The Chariot stands in both the male and the female rule: both branches passed on the same thing — speed and push, arrive first. When both branches say one thing, the rule looks like the only possible one right up to the day someone says it out loud. The Lovers in the passing-on position change the question from “how do I make it in time” to “with whom exactly”. In practice it looks like this: a person is used to deciding fast, but what is asked of them is to choose, and the choice drags on to the last minute, because speed is no help in that kind of question. The repeat here matters more than the numbers themselves.

article_sections.h2: Practice: rewrite one rule you pass on
paragraphs: Pick a repeating sentence or reaction whose origin you know. Write down three lines: the use of the rule — what it gives; the price — what it costs; the H action — how it gets passed on through your tone, a ban, a condition. Then put together a new version so that the use stays and the other person gets the right to answer. Try the wording in one calm situation and judge the result by the quality of contact: did the conversation continue, did the person come back with a question. One rule at a time is enough — an inheritance gets rewritten line by line.

faq.q: What does karma with parents and children show in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: Three points: two principles received from the male and the female branch, and the way you carry them on yourself. The section collects family values and everyday models of behaviour, not the biographies of your relatives. What you get at the end is a list of what you want to keep and of what repeats automatically.

faq.q: Karma with parents in the destiny matrix — where do I start the reading?
faq.a: Start with facts: which sentence was repeated at home, how people asked for help, what they did after a row. Then put arcana F and G next to those facts and see which rule you recognise. A guess with no episode behind it is better left as a guess.

faq.q: What does the arcanum of children mean in the destiny matrix?
faq.a: There is no separate arcanum of children in the calculation: the material male line H covers the passing on. It describes your way of bringing someone up, explaining and setting limits, not the character or the number of children. It reads best as an action: what you do when a younger person gets something wrong.

faq.q: How do I read relationships with parents by date of birth?
faq.a: The date of birth gives two family arcana, F and G. Each is a guess about the rule of a branch, not a fact about a particular person. Check it against what you remember and know, and work first of all on the rule that is already running in your own behaviour.

faq.q: Does the section suit a person without children?
faq.a: Yes. H describes how rules are passed on in care, in teaching and in leading — anywhere your decisions affect someone more vulnerable. The method makes no forecast about a birth or about a child’s character.

items.title: Family tasks down to the seventh generation
items.lead: A wide family view, without literally counting seven generations.
items.formula: the material female I, the totals of both family branches and the planetary purpose
meaning: Sometimes a family story is recognisable from the first sentence: the women of one branch carry everything alone, the men of the other start from scratch in every generation, and any talk about money ends in the same row. The family line section helps you see that repeat not as a curse, but as a story you can still continue differently.

In the calculation this is not seven separate generations and not a list of ancestors’ fates. The section joins the material female point I, the result of the male branch, the result of the female branch and the planetary purpose. The phrase “to the seventh generation” names an angle of reading: the calculator does not work out seven personal arcana for seven generations.

It helps to separate the observable fact from the pretty version first. A repeated divorce, a ceiling on money or the habit of staying silent about a conflict can be checked against family stories; what they mean stays a subject for conversation, not a final verdict on the family. That keeps the section alive: it does not hand out blame, it shows where a person has a choice.

A strong reading does not require a war with the past. It helps you name the inherited way of acting, keep what is useful in it and drop the price the family used to pay automatically. A practical step: ask the older relatives about two or three similar forks in the road and compare which ending kept repeating and which one nobody has tried yet.
items.reading: Read I as the concrete material theme of the female branch, then the totals of both lines, and only then the planetary level. Seven generations are a frame for interpretation, not seven separate calculations.
